source: Orientation pieces recoloured by exact hex swap (nightshift_kit.py) plus the Night Shift shadow and lit-edge passes, shared pieces from shared_pieces.py, Night Shift pieces and landmark; build_nightshift.py

entries.name: floor_j
entries.note: Night Shift floor, slab corner: joint on the top row and the left column. Dark cool slate, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_h
entries.note: Night Shift floor, slab edge: joint on the top row. Dark cool slate, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_v
entries.note: Night Shift floor, slab edge: joint on the left column. Dark cool slate, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_p
entries.note: Night Shift floor, slab interior, plain. Dark cool slate, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_chip
entries.note: 2x1 px wear mark on the floor layer; placed with a pixel offset

entries.name: route_inlay
entries.note: 1 px inlay line in muted silver (glass step 2) that marks a lit route; repeat every 16 px (horizontal). Brighter than the floor, so a route reads on the dark slate without a label

entries.name: route_inlay_v
entries.note: route_inlay turned 90 degrees: the same line for vertical corridor edges

entries.name: route_arrow_e
entries.note: warm wayfinding arrow inlaid in the floor, pointing east (accent steps 2 and 3, 3.4:1 and above against the floor fill); place on bare floor, outside a lamp pool

entries.name: route_arrow_n
entries.note: the same arrow pointing north

entries.name: wall_n_plain
entries.note: north wall segment: lit cap (silver top edge and trim), deep indigo face, baseboard, contact shadow darker than the floor; tiles horizontally

entries.name: wall_n_window_a
entries.note: high window overlay for the north wall: silver-edged dark frame, indigo pane, one stepped reflection band, lit sill

entries.name: wall_n_window_b
entries.note: high window overlay for the north wall: silver-edged dark frame, indigo pane, one stepped reflection band, lit sill

entries.name: wall_e_plain
entries.note: east wall segment, side plane; the lit trim line is silver. Tiles vertically. Content starts 4 px into the first cell

entries.name: wall_n_noticeboard
entries.note: noticeboard overlay for the north wall: silver frame, cork board, four pinned notes (one warm). Place at the wall's pixel row 9; the break room's pinned practice reminders

entries.name: service_door_closed
entries.note: both glass leaves shut: warm lamp-ramp frame, leaves, seam, pulls, stair sign on a lit plate

entries.name: service_door_half
entries.note: leaves slid 8 px into the jamb pockets: the corridor beyond shows through

entries.name: service_door_open
entries.note: leaves fully in the pockets (15 px): the doorway is open and the threshold is lit

entries.name: lamp
entries.note: floor lamp: post with a silver left edge, warm head with one lit step, contact shadow

entries.name: lamp_off
entries.note: unlit lamp: head in the ink ramp, no glow

entries.name: lamp_glow_on
entries.note: glow, one hard step in the lamp ramp (accent step 2), radius 5.2. Paints only where the floor is the bare fill #4C5865

entries.name: lamp_glow_pulse
entries.note: pulse frame of the glow, radius 6.4; alternate with lamp_glow_on at about 600 ms each

entries.name: pool_desk_fill
entries.note: Pool of desk light, 52x22 px: centre sits 14 px below the desk's footprint origin and 17 px right, so place it at the desk's cell. This entry recolours the bare floor fill (#4C5865) to #B8745A; place it with pool_desk_seam.

entries.name: pool_desk_seam
entries.note: Pool of desk light, 52x22 px: centre sits 14 px below the desk's footprint origin and 17 px right, so place it at the desk's cell. This entry recolours the slab joints and wear chips (#364049) to #7A4A4A; place it with pool_desk_fill.

entries.name: pool_route_fill
entries.note: Route pool, 44x22 px, placement point = centre. Spaced every 4 to 5 cells along a route it makes the route brighter than its dead ends. This entry recolours the bare floor fill (#4C5865) to #B8745A; place it with pool_route_seam.

entries.name: pool_route_seam
entries.note: Route pool, 44x22 px, placement point = centre. Spaced every 4 to 5 cells along a route it makes the route brighter than its dead ends. This entry recolours the slab joints and wear chips (#364049) to #7A4A4A; place it with pool_route_fill.

entries.name: pool_door_fill
entries.note: Doorway pool, 26x40 px, placement point = centre. Put it on the floor in front of a door so the doorway is the brightest thing in the wall. This entry recolours the bare floor fill (#4C5865) to #B8745A; place it with pool_door_seam.

entries.name: pool_door_seam
entries.note: Doorway pool, 26x40 px, placement point = centre. Put it on the floor in front of a door so the doorway is the brightest thing in the wall. This entry recolours the slab joints and wear chips (#364049) to #7A4A4A; place it with pool_door_fill.

entries.name: pool_break_fill
entries.note: Break-room pool, 62x22 px, placement point = centre: the safe, well-lit place at the start of the district. This entry recolours the bare floor fill (#4C5865) to #B8745A; place it with pool_break_seam.

entries.name: pool_break_seam
entries.note: Break-room pool, 62x22 px, placement point = centre: the safe, well-lit place at the start of the district. This entry recolours the slab joints and wear chips (#364049) to #7A4A4A; place it with pool_break_fill.

entries.name: pool_ledger_fill
entries.note: Ledger pool, 40x20 px: centre 16 px right and 8 px below the ledger desk's footprint origin. This entry recolours the bare floor fill (#4C5865) to #B8745A; place it with pool_ledger_seam.

entries.name: pool_ledger_seam
entries.note: Ledger pool, 40x20 px: centre 16 px right and 8 px below the ledger desk's footprint origin. This entry recolours the slab joints and wear chips (#364049) to #7A4A4A; place it with pool_ledger_fill.

entries.name: desk_dead_a
entries.note: legacy station gone dark: dim wood, ink screen with one pale glint, keyboard, paper and a small plant; a and b differ only in the plant leaves. The chair is a separate entry

entries.name: desk_dead_b
entries.note: legacy station gone dark: dim wood, ink screen with one pale glint, keyboard, paper and a small plant; a and b differ only in the plant leaves. The chair is a separate entry

entries.name: desk_lit_a
entries.note: working station: dim wood, silver-lit screen, keyboard, paper and a small plant; a and b differ only in the plant leaves. The chair is a separate entry

entries.name: desk_lit_b
entries.note: working station: dim wood, silver-lit screen, keyboard, paper and a small plant; a and b differ only in the plant leaves. The chair is a separate entry

entries.name: chair
entries.note: indigo task chair seen from above with a silver edge; place 11 px right and 18 px below a desk origin

entries.name: pot_plant_a
entries.note: slate planter with a night-green plant; four leaf layouts (a to d); silver edge on the upper-left of pot and leaves

entries.name: pot_plant_b
entries.note: slate planter with a night-green plant; four leaf layouts (a to d); silver edge on the upper-left of pot and leaves

entries.name: pot_plant_c
entries.note: slate planter with a night-green plant; four leaf layouts (a to d); silver edge on the upper-left of pot and leaves

entries.name: pot_plant_d
entries.note: slate planter with a night-green plant; four leaf layouts (a to d); silver edge on the upper-left of pot and leaves

entries.name: sofa
entries.note: break-room lounge sofa seen from above, dim terracotta wood

entries.name: side_table
entries.note: round slate side table with a small plant

entries.name: shelf_1x1
entries.note: 1-cell archive shelving for the ledger room: top plane, front face with three bays, boxes in warm, indigo, slate and wood clusters, kick plate; silver edge

entries.name: shelf_2x1_a
entries.note: 2-cell archive shelving for the ledger room: top plane, front face with three bays, boxes in warm, indigo, slate and wood clusters, kick plate; silver edge; a and b differ only in the box layout

entries.name: shelf_2x1_b
entries.note: 2-cell archive shelving for the ledger room: top plane, front face with three bays, boxes in warm, indigo, slate and wood clusters, kick plate; silver edge; a and b differ only in the box layout

entries.name: partition_1x1
entries.note: security-glass partition, one cell: dark frame with a silver cap, indigo pane, one reflection band, floor rail

entries.name: partition_2x1
entries.note: security-glass partition, two cells, with a middle post and a reflection band per pane

entries.name: terminal_desk
entries.note: two-cell console desk: ink housing first, then a silver-lit screen, a one-step glow on the desk top, keyboard and card reader

entries.name: cabinet_1x1
entries.note: dim wood filing cabinet, one cell: paper stack on the top plane, three drawers with label plates

entries.name: break_counter
entries.note: break-room counter: kettle, two mugs and a small warm lamp on a dim wood top, three cupboard doors; the warm lamp is the focus of the pool_break light

entries.name: ledger_desk
entries.note: the ledger desk: an open ledger with a bookmark and one warm lamp whose shade is the brightest warm pixel in the room; footprint 2x1

entries.name: vestibule_gate_closed
entries.note: security vestibule gate, two security-glass posts with card readers and an amber lock bar across the glass leaf: cols 0-3 block. Contact shadows are baked per piece

entries.name: vestibule_gate_open
entries.note: security vestibule gate, the leaf folded edge-on against the left post, readers switched to silver: cols 1-2 are a two-cell walkway. Contact shadows are baked per piece

entries.name: bench
entries.note: slatted bench (rich-finish decor), dim terracotta wood

entries.name: bench_v
entries.note: vertical-plank bench, 10 x 28 px (rich-finish decor), dim terracotta wood

entries.name: window_wall_base
entries.note: the 12-cell wall run: night wall tiles, silver head rail and left jamb, six mullions, silver sill. Carries the collision of the whole run

entries.name: window_panes_before
entries.note: before: six panes of dark glass, an empty unlit room beyond

entries.name: window_panes_after
entries.note: after: the room beyond is lit warm: strip light, pendant lamps with a halo step, a shelf of mugs, a lit floor strip

entries.name: window_figs_after_a
entries.note: after: three coworker silhouettes behind the glass, cropped by the sill, with a warm rim (frame a)

entries.name: window_figs_after_b
entries.note: after: the same three silhouettes one step later (two have moved): alternate a and b at about 700 ms to make them move independently

entries.name: window_glass
entries.note: reflection bands over the panes, one stepped band each, drawn above the interior and the silhouettes in both states

entries.name: window_spill_after
entries.note: after: the lit room spills six slanted bands of warm light on the floor below the window (accent step 0); composited only on the bare floor fill

entries.name: window_spill_core_after
entries.note: after: the brighter core of each band (accent step 1); composited only where the spill band is already accent step 0, so draw it after window_spill_after

entries.name: reader_pedestal_locked
entries.note: a free-standing card-reader pedestal for the security vestibule, 12 x 22, 1 x 1 (level 17). locked: an amber status LED. It blocks its cell in both states (the gate, not the pedestal, opens the way)

entries.name: reader_pedestal_open
entries.note: a free-standing card-reader pedestal for the security vestibule, 12 x 22, 1 x 1 (level 17). open: the status LEDs are silver, the reader confirmed. It blocks its cell in both states (the gate, not the pedestal, opens the way)

entries.name: exit_sign_dim
entries.note: the vestibule's back-exit sign (level 17: a vestibule with a clear back exit), a 24 x 10 wall plate with a stair and an arrow. dim: a dull plate, the icon barely visible. Place above the back exit; the plain wall already blocks

entries.name: exit_sign_lit
entries.note: the vestibule's back-exit sign (level 17: a vestibule with a clear back exit), a 24 x 10 wall plate with a stair and an arrow. lit: a warm plate with the icon in ink. Place above the back exit; the plain wall already blocks

entries.name: north_stair_closed
entries.note: the north stair door of level 18 (Ada opens the north stair), a north-wall door 32 x 34 px that replaces two plain wall tiles and carries their cap: a stair sign on the lintel. closed: a silver lock grille with an amber lock bar; blocks. Do not put plain wall tiles under it

entries.name: north_stair_open
entries.note: the north stair door of level 18 (Ada opens the north stair), a north-wall door 32 x 34 px that replaces two plain wall tiles and carries their cap: a stair sign on the lintel. open: the grille is folded to the left, the stair climbs to a warm landing; walkable. Do not put plain wall tiles under it

entries.name: carpet_cue_a
entries.note: a 3 x 2 rug on the floor markings (level 18: the Caps route uses varied lamp and carpet cues): indigo diamonds with a blue border. Darker than the slate floor, so people keep the moonlight rim on it; never uses the lamp-pool accent steps 0 and 1. Walkable

entries.name: carpet_cue_b
entries.note: a 3 x 2 rug on the floor markings (level 18: the Caps route uses varied lamp and carpet cues): warm stripes with a wood border. Darker than the slate floor, so people keep the moonlight rim on it; never uses the lamp-pool accent steps 0 and 1. Walkable

entries.name: carpet_cue_c
entries.note: a 3 x 2 rug on the floor markings (level 18: the Caps route uses varied lamp and carpet cues): green chevrons with a green border. Darker than the slate floor, so people keep the moonlight rim on it; never uses the lamp-pool accent steps 0 and 1. Walkable

entries.name: courier_chute_idle
entries.note: Mira's courier chute, 2 x 1: a metal cabinet with a slot, a tube rising into the ceiling, a catch tray and an indicator lamp. idle: the lamp is dull, the slot empty. Silver edge

entries.name: courier_chute_ready
entries.note: Mira's courier chute, 2 x 1: a metal cabinet with a slot, a tube rising into the ceiling, a catch tray and an indicator lamp. ready (Mira has a route to offer): a slip stands in the slot and the lamp is lit warm. Silver edge

entries.name: mira_decor_night_courier
entries.note: Night Courier reward (after level 18): a small satchel with a warm strap and a crescent charm; a desk decoration, 1 x 1, no collision. Silver edge

entries.name: break_counter_dim
entries.note: the break-room counter in its dim state (levels 17 and 19: the break room is not yet warm): the same counter with the lamp off, the kettle cold and no glow on the top plane

entries.name: pool_breaktop_fill
entries.note: Break-counter pool, 62x22 px: centre 24 px right and 14 px below the break counter's footprint origin, so a state set can carry the counter and its pool together. This entry recolours the bare floor fill (#4C5865) to #B8745A; place it with pool_breaktop_seam.

entries.name: pool_breaktop_seam
entries.note: Break-counter pool, 62x22 px: centre 24 px right and 14 px below the break counter's footprint origin, so a state set can carry the counter and its pool together. This entry recolours the slab joints and wear chips (#364049) to #7A4A4A; place it with pool_breaktop_fill.

entries.name: elevator_closed
entries.note: elevator, doors shut: two steel leaves meet at a centre seam, a casing with two lamps, a lit floor indicator, a lit LIFT mat in front. Orientation's module in the nightshift ramps (shared_pieces.elevator_doors): 3 x 3 cells, rows 0-1 are the north wall, row 2 the lit mat. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns

entries.name: elevator_half
entries.note: elevator, leaves slid 6 px into the jamb pockets: the warm cab shows between them. Orientation's module in the nightshift ramps (shared_pieces.elevator_doors): 3 x 3 cells, rows 0-1 are the north wall, row 2 the lit mat. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns

entries.name: elevator_open
entries.note: elevator, leaves fully in the pockets (11 px, a 1 px lip stays): the cab is open and the centre cell walks in. Orientation's module in the nightshift ramps (shared_pieces.elevator_doors): 3 x 3 cells, rows 0-1 are the north wall, row 2 the lit mat. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns

entries.name: elevator_call_panel
entries.note: wall call panel for the elevator, nightshift ramps (shared_pieces.elevator_call_panel): steel plate, small lit display, up and down buttons. Overlay on wall_n_plain (no collision of its own); place it on the wall face 9 px below the wall top, one cell beside the elevator

entries.name: elevator_call_panel_executive_lit
entries.note: the call panel with the Executive stop lit: the display's second bar and the up button in the lit warm step (revealed by level 19). Same geometry as elevator_call_panel

entries.name: artifact_ada_shift_book
entries.note: Ada's shift book (Night Shift level 19): a small closed book with a name label and a ribbon marker. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale glass-step glint at the upper left as the inspectable cue (never a UI marker colour). No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: wall_w_plain
entries.note: west wall segment, side plane seen from inside (the face between the service corridor and the hall): ink mass with a 1 px silver line on its left (the edge that catches the upper-left light) and its room-facing edge on the right. That face looks away from the light, so its trim is a dim indigo step, not the silver of wall_e_plain, which cannot be mirrored. Tiles vertically; no collision of its own (the map blocks the wall elsewhere). Place so its right edge is the cell boundary: the sprite fills the cell's left 13 px

entries.name: desk_dawn_lamp
entries.note: Desk for Dawn reward: a small desk lamp (wood foot and stem under a warm shade with one lit step and a pale glint), 10 x 13, 1 x 1, no collision, silver edge. A desk decoration like mail_tray and desk_folder; never placed on the map

service_door.note: play forward on approach, backward on leave; Orientation's sliding glass door recoloured with a lamp-ramp frame and a stair sign

lamp.note: glow states: off, on (steady), pulse (wider ring). Wake = off -> on; idle breathing = on <-> pulse. Level 18: each repaired ticket wakes a different lamp.

vestibule_gate.note: the security vestibule gate (level 17): opens after the player confirms the practice-mode exit; open leaves a two-cell walkway

station_a.note: an office station that wakes (level 18: each repaired ticket wakes a different lamp): the legacy desk goes dark to lit and its pool of desk light switches on. Place at the desk's cell; the chair is a separate entry

station_b.note: the b variant of station_a (plant leaves differ)

window_figs.note: the silhouettes behind the interior window in the after state; swap window_figs_after_a for this loop (level 19: silhouettes move independently)

reader_pedestal.note: level 17: the vestibule reader confirms; pair with vestibule_gate

exit_sign.note: level 17: the back-exit sign comes on once the player confirms the exit instruction

north_stair.note: level 18: Ada opens the north stair; open leaves rows 0-1 of its cells walkable

courier_chute.note: Mira's chute: ready while she has a route to offer (Lights-Out Delivery, after level 18)

break_room.note: levels 17 and 19: the break room's warm-light state. Place at the counter's cell; warm adds the counter's lit lamp and its pool of light. The long window's own light is the interior_window landmark

corridor_light.note: level 19: the service corridor lights up. Place one per 4 to 5 cells along the corridor: an unlit lamp, then the lamp with a pool of route light centred on it

elevator.note: play forward on approach or arrival, backward on leave; only open lets the centre cell through (the same set as Orientation's, in the district ramps)

elevator_panel.note: level 19: the Executive stop lights on the call panel

interior_window.note: Night Shift landmark: the long interior window of the break room, 12 cells of glazing along a wall. Every part is a full-size sprite registered at one footprint origin, so a state is a list of parts; place them all at the same cell. The base carries the wall's collision; the spill parts are on the light layer and only recolour bare floor.
changes_after: the room behind the glass lights warm: strip light, pendant lamps and a lit floor (levels.md 18-19: the break room gains warm light)
three coworker silhouettes appear behind the panes (levels.md 18: a coworker silhouette appears behind the interior window; 19: silhouettes move independently, frames a and b)
six slanted bands of warm light fall on the floor below the window
both end lamps switch from the steady glow to the wider pulse glow
